CHOICE: 1
CONFIDENCE: 3

The formula in Solution 1, (7·2^{2e-5}+4)/3, gives 6 at e=3, which matches the known count of 6 skew morphisms of Z_8. It also satisfies the recurrence S_e = 4S_{e-1} − 4 that Solution 1 states. I recall this closed form from the Kovács–Nedela work on skew-morphisms of cyclic p-groups, but I could not verify it against the source here, so my confidence is moderate. Solution 2's count 2^e − 2 grows far too slowly to be right. Solution 3 gives 10 at e=3, which contradicts the known value of 6.
